paragraphs: Rav Pinhas bar Rav Mari. Zevahim 4b. Yuhasin brings Rav Pinhas son of Rav Mari bar Issur the convert. It appears that he erred, because Rav Mari bar Issur the convert did not have a son named Pinhas (see Rav Aha the Elder).
